entries.title: Exodus 16:1
segments: ¶And they journeyed from Elim, and all the congregation of the children of Israel came to the Wilderness of Sin, which is between Elim and Sinai, on the fifteenth day of the second month after they departed from the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 16:2
segments: Then the whole congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and Aaron in the wilderness.

entries.title: Exodus 16:3
segments: And the children of Israel said to them, "Oh, that we had died by the hand of the LORD in the land of Egypt, when we sat by the pots of meat [and] when we ate bread to the full! For you have brought us out into this wilderness to kill this whole assembly with hunger."

entries.title: Exodus 16:4
segments: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you. And the people shall go out and gather a certain quota every day, that I may test them, whether they will walk in My law or not.

entries.title: Exodus 16:5
segments: "And it shall be on the sixth day that they shall prepare what they bring in, and it shall be twice as much as they gather daily."

entries.title: Exodus 16:6
segments: Then Moses and Aaron said to all the children of Israel, "At evening you shall know that the LORD has brought you out of the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Exodus 16:7
segments: "And in the morning you shall see the glory of the LORD; for He hears your complaints against the LORD. But what [are] we, that you complain against us?"

entries.title: Exodus 16:8
segments: Also Moses said, "[This shall be seen] when the LORD gives you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to the full; for the LORD hears your complaints which you make against Him. And what [are] we? Your complaints [are] not against us but against the LORD."

entries.title: Exodus 16:9
segments: Then Moses spoke to Aaron, "Say to all the congregation of the children of Israel, 'Come near before the LORD, for He has heard your complaints.'"

entries.title: Exodus 16:10
segments: Now it came to pass, as Aaron spoke to the whole congregation of the children of Israel, that they looked toward the wilderness, and behold, the glory of the LORD appeared in the cloud.

entries.title: Exodus 16:11
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 16:12
segments: "I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel. Speak to them, saying, 'At twilight you shall eat meat, and in the morning you shall be filled with bread. And you shall know that I [am] the LORD your God.'"

entries.title: Exodus 16:13
segments: ¶So it was that quails came up at evening and covered the camp, and in the morning the dew lay all around the camp.

entries.title: Exodus 16:14
segments: And when the layer of dew lifted, there, on the surface of the wilderness, was a small round substance, [as] fine as frost on the ground.

entries.title: Exodus 16:15
segments: So when the children of Israel saw [it], they said to one another, "What is it?" For they did not know what it [was]. And Moses said to them, "This [is] the bread which the LORD has given you to eat.

entries.title: Exodus 16:16
segments: "This is the thing which the LORD has commanded: 'Let every man gather it according to each one's need, one omer for each person, [according to the] number of persons; let every man take for [those] who [are] in his tent.'"

entries.title: Exodus 16:17
segments: Then the children of Israel did so and gathered, some more, some less.

entries.title: Exodus 16:18
segments: So when they measured [it] by omers, he who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack. Every man had gathered according to each one's need.

entries.title: Exodus 16:19
segments: And Moses said, "Let no one leave any of it till morning."

entries.title: Exodus 16:20
segments: Notwithstanding they did not heed Moses. But some of them left part of it until morning, and it bred worms and stank. And Moses was angry with them.

entries.title: Exodus 16:21
segments: So they gathered it every morning, every man according to his need. And when the sun became hot, it melted.

entries.title: Exodus 16:22
segments: ¶And so it was, on the sixth day, [that] they gathered twice as much bread, two omers for each one. And all the rulers of the congregation came and told Moses.

entries.title: Exodus 16:23
segments: Then he said to them, "This [is what] the LORD has said: 'Tomorrow [is] a Sabbath rest, a holy Sabbath to the LORD. Bake what you will bake [today], and boil what you will boil; and lay up for yourselves all that remains, to be kept until morning.'"

entries.title: Exodus 16:24
segments: So they laid it up till morning, as Moses commanded; and it did not stink, nor were there any worms in it.

entries.title: Exodus 16:25
segments: Then Moses said, "Eat that today, for today [is] a Sabbath to the LORD; today you will not find it in the field.

entries.title: Exodus 16:26
segments: "Six days you shall gather it, but on the seventh day, [which is] the Sabbath, there will be none."

entries.title: Exodus 16:27
segments: Now it happened [that some] of the people went out on the seventh day to gather, but they found none.

entries.title: Exodus 16:28
segments: And the LORD said to Moses, "How long do you refuse to keep My commandments and My laws?

entries.title: Exodus 16:29
segments: "See! For the LORD has given you the Sabbath; therefore He gives you on the sixth day bread for two days. Let every man remain in his place; let no man go out of his place on the seventh day."

entries.title: Exodus 16:30
segments: So the people rested on the seventh day.

entries.title: Exodus 16:31
segments: And the house of Israel called its name Manna. And it [was] like white coriander seed, and the taste of it [was] like wafers [made] with honey.

entries.title: Exodus 16:32
segments: ¶Then Moses said, "This [is] the thing which the LORD has commanded: 'Fill an omer with it, to be kept for your generations, that they may see the bread with which I fed you in the wilderness, when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.'"

entries.title: Exodus 16:33
segments: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take a pot and put an omer of manna in it, and lay it up before the LORD, to be kept for your generations."

entries.title: Exodus 16:34
segments: As the LORD commanded Moses, so Aaron laid it up before the Testimony, to be kept.

entries.title: Exodus 16:35
segments: And the children of Israel ate manna forty years, until they came to an inhabited land; they ate manna until they came to the border of the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Exodus 16:36
segments: Now an omer [is] one-tenth of an ephah.
